def user_prompt(payload):
    return (payload['prompt'] + '\n\nCONTEXT_JSON:\n' + encode(payload['context'])
        + '\n\nOUTPUT_JSON_SCHEMA:\n' + encode(payload['output_schema'])
        + '\n\nWrite ' + payload['marker'] + ' exactly once on its own line. '
          'You may explain your complete chart analysis in prose. '
          'Then return exactly one fenced JSON object satisfying OUTPUT_JSON_SCHEMA. '
          'Do not add the operation marker as a JSON property. '
          'Use the complete attached Futures charts when images are supplied. '
          'Do not reuse a previous conversation or quote another operation marker.')
